listings.title: Haier mini fridge, 1.7 cu ft
listings.description: Small white dorm fridge, runs quiet and keeps stuff cold. Moving out so need it gone.

listings.title: CHEM 101 textbook: Chemistry, A Molecular Approach (Tro)
listings.description: Used for CHEM 101, some highlighting in the first few chapters. Spine is still solid.

listings.title: MATH 231 textbook: Calculus Early Transcendentals (Stewart)
listings.description: Stewart calc book for MATH 231, no torn pages. Doesn't include the online code.

listings.title: ECON 101 textbook: Principles of Economics (Mankiw)
listings.description: Mankiw for ECON 101, barely opened. Pencil notes only.

listings.title: BIOL 101 textbook: Campbell Biology
listings.description: Big Campbell Biology book, good for intro bio like BIOL 101. Cover has a little wear but pages are clean.

listings.title: PSYC 101 textbook: Psychology (Myers & DeWall)
listings.description: Used PSYC 101 book, a few highlighted chapters. Great for studying for the exams.

listings.title: Intro Python book: Python Crash Course (Matthes)
listings.description: Beginner Python book, handy for COMP 110 or any intro programming class. Good shape, no writing inside.

listings.title: Wood frame futon
listings.description: Full size futon with a green patterned cover, folds flat into a bed. You'll need to help carry it down the stairs.

listings.title: White hybrid bike
listings.description: Comfy hybrid bike, 21 speeds, perfect for getting across campus. Tires were just pumped up.

listings.title: Turkish style kilim rug, about 4x6
listings.description: Colorful flatweave rug that makes a dorm room feel less sad. Low pile, easy to clean.

listings.title: 17 inch LCD monitor
listings.description: Black 17in monitor with a VGA cable. Works fine as a second screen.

listings.title: Silver countertop microwave
listings.description: 700W microwave, heats up ramen just fine. Plate and all, clean inside.

listings.title: Carolina blue knit scarf
listings.description: Handmade blue scarf with fringe, good for cold game days. Never worn much.

listings.title: Heavy duty bike U-lock
listings.description: Sturdy U-lock with two keys. Got a new one so selling this.

listings.title: TI-89 Titanium graphing calculator
listings.description: Works perfectly, comes with the slide cover. Good for MATH and PHYS classes.

listings.title: Gray rolling desk chair
listings.description: Comfy office chair with arm rests that rolls smoothly. Seat has no rips.

listings.title: Green plastic laundry basket
listings.description: Big laundry basket with handles, fits a whole week of clothes. A little scuffed.

listings.title: Hamilton Beach coffee maker
listings.description: 12 cup coffee maker with a thermal carafe, keeps coffee hot for hours. Cleaned with vinegar.

listings.title: JBL Charge 3 bluetooth speaker
listings.description: Loud portable speaker, battery still lasts all day. Charging cable included.

listings.title: 50L hiking backpack
listings.description: Blue hiking pack with a ton of pockets, tag still on. Never actually took it hiking.

listings.title: 3 shelf wooden bookcase
listings.description: Light wood bookcase, sturdy and easy to move. Fits all your textbooks and DVDs.

listings.title: Blue USB desk fan
listings.description: Little blue desk fan, great for those hot dorm nights. Two speeds.

listings.title: White electric kettle
listings.description: 1.7L Philips electric kettle, boils fast for tea or noodles. Works great.

listings.title: Houndstooth bean bag chair
listings.description: Big comfy bean bag, super nice for reading or gaming. Cover is clean.

wants.queryText: full length mirror for my dorm
